definitions.explanation: a face-to-face discussion or meeting, often for evaluation, consultation, or formal discussion

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}と{面談|めんだん}がある。
examples.english: I have a meeting with my boss.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{面談|めんだん}を{行|おこな}う。
{保護者|ほごしゃ}{面談|めんだん}が{来週|らいしゅう}ある。
examples.english: There's a parent-teacher conference next week.

examples.japanese: {面談|めんだん}で{今後|こんご}のキャリアについて{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed future career plans in the meeting.

examples.japanese: {三十分|さんじゅっぷん}の{面談|めんだん}を{予約|よやく}した。

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: {面談|めんだん}する (to have an interview/meeting)

COMMON TYPES:
- {個人|こじん}{面談|めんだん} (individual meeting)
- {保護者|ほごしゃ}{面談|めんだん} (parent-teacher conference)
- {就職|しゅうしょく}{面談|めんだん} (job interview - though {面接|めんせつ} more common)
- {進路|しんろ}{面談|めんだん} (career guidance meeting)

RELATED WORDS:
- {面接|めんせつ} (job interview - more formal)
- {会談|かいだん} (talks, conference - more official)
- {相談|そうだん} (consultation - less formal)
- ミーティング (meeting - loanword)

NUANCE:
{面談|めんだん} emphasizes a face-to-face discussion and is commonly used in business and educational settings.
